answer_2.quote: We compute the cross entropy between the human interpretation of quantifiers P h from Section 5.1 and L M (p|q) to measure the similarity of quantifier interpretation between humans and M.

answer_4.quote: We employ 25 Mechanical Turk annotators who are tasked with providing the percentage scope of quantifiers.
answer_4.guideline: The users are expected to pick one/two numerical percentages from the provided list of percentages such that most accurately bound the range of the given quantifier to the best of his/her knowledge and online searching is not encouraged.
